_comment: Special Arts (DESIGN section 8). Each art: element ('any' for all), level gate, a master NPC somewhere in the world and a quest (steps in order). Step types: talk (speak to the master), visit (reach every point; night = only counts at night), kill (defeat enemies; filter enemy|fighter|player, zone optional, night optional), meditate (stand still within radius of each point for seconds). passive arts need no slot; the rest go in the Art slot (T). ability uses the normal ability fields plus: heal, cleanse, charge, grapple, nightOnly, wallSeconds, stamina, vulnerable.

arts.name: Healing
arts.text: Channel water to heal allies around you and wash away burns.
arts.limits: Healing is halved while you are fighting other players.

master.name: Mother Senna
master.title: Healer
master.hint: A healer tends a spirit spring west of the Lantern Monastery.

lines.offer: Water remembers every wound it has washed. Will you learn to listen?
lines.progress: The springs are waiting. Drink from each, then return.
lines.done: Your hands are steady now. Heal well, and never in anger.

arts.name: Lightning
arts.text: Charge for 1.5 seconds, then strike in an instant line.
arts.limits: You can't move while charging. A firebender who knows Lightning can redirect it with a perfectly timed block.

master.name: Old Kazan
master.title: Storm Hermit
master.hint: An old hermit lives on Storm Peak, the high summit north of the Tide Shrine.

lines.offer: Lightning is cold fire. Separate yin from yang, or it will separate you.
lines.progress: Prove your fire against real opponents, then sit with the storm.
lines.done: The storm answers you now. Never aim it at your heart.

arts.name: Metalbending
arts.text: Fire a metal cable: it drags enemies to you, or pulls you to the ground it strikes.
arts.limits: Pulls hardest on armored targets (Stone Armor, shields).

master.name: Forgemaster Ruk
master.title: Metal Sage
master.hint: The miners of Ironhollow, east of the Free Isles harbor, know a metal sage.

lines.offer: Metal is earth that forgot it was earth. Remind it.
lines.progress: Find the ore veins and feel the impurities in each.
lines.done: Iron listens now. Use it well.

arts.name: Lavabending
arts.text: Melt the ground where you aim into a lava pool that burns enemies.
arts.limits: Long cooldown. The lava cools into a rock wall after 8 seconds.

master.name: Ashmother Vey
master.title: Volcano Master
master.hint: Smoke rises from Ember Crater, the peak west of the Ember Shrine.

lines.offer: Earth with fire in its belly. Do you have the patience to boil stone?
lines.progress: Fight in the contested lands, then sit in the crater's heat.
lines.done: The mountain's blood flows for you. Respect it.

arts.name: Combustion
arts.text: A long-range explosive shot from the third eye.
arts.limits: Telegraphed with a visible glow; 45 second cooldown. (The design's world-boss scroll arrives with world bosses in Phase 10.)

master.name: The Third Eye
master.title: Combustion Adept
master.hint: Someone meditates on the southern summit beyond the Ash Syndicate's den.

lines.offer: Focus everything into one point. Then let it go.
lines.progress: Bring down your enemies and walk every shrine. Focus comes from discipline.
lines.done: Your mind is a fuse. Light it rarely.

arts.name: Glider
arts.text: Press jump in the air to open your glider; release to drop.
arts.limits: Glides down, never up. Taking a hit closes it.

arts.name: Flight
arts.text: Free flight on a stamina bar. Jump climbs, sprint dives.
arts.limits: No offensive bending while flying; stamina drains twice as fast in combat.

master.name: Abbot Wen
master.title: Windspire Abbot
master.hint: The Windspire Monastery sits on the summit north of the Free Isles harbor.

lines.offer: To fly, you must let go of the ground inside you.
lines.progress: Stand on the high places. Feel how small the world is.
lines.done: The sky is yours. Come back down sometimes.

arts.name: Bloodbending
arts.text: At night, seize one enemy within 10 m: hold them in place and drag them toward you for 2 seconds.
arts.limits: Night only (stronger under a full moon). 60 second cooldown and a huge chi cost. Order players who learn it lose a faction rank and gain a bounty; the Hollow Moon Cult has no penalty.

master.name: The Pale Lady
master.title: Forbidden Master
master.hint: On moonlit nights, a pale woman is seen on the far southern hills past the Hollow Moon temple.

lines.offer: Everything that lives is mostly water. Did your teachers never tell you that?
lines.progress: Under the moon only. Take three who stand against you.
lines.done: Now you know. You can never not know.
lines.day: Come back when the moon is up.

steps.text: Return to the Pale Lady at night

arts.name: Spirit Projection
arts.text: Leave your body as a spirit for 15 seconds: scout ahead and see every enemy nearby.
arts.limits: Your body can't move and takes 50% more damage while you are out.

master.name: The Wanderer
master.title: Spirit Guide
master.hint: A wanderer sits under the old tree on Heart Hill, near the middle of the world.

lines.offer: The other world is closer than you think. Sit with me.
lines.progress: Meditate at each shrine until the spirits notice you.
